summary: Oncolytics Biotech Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a press release announcing updated clinical data from its REO 022 study in metastatic colorectal cancer. The release reports a 19.5-month median duration of response with pelareorep-based therapy versus a 4-6 month historical benchmark, and a 33% objective response rate. The company is engaging with the FDA regarding a potential accelerated approval pathway. No corporate transaction, capital structure change, or special situation event is described. The filing is a routine clinical update with no deal terms or strategic corporate action.
